title: shell sells risec interest constellation 715 mln acquires hunlock creek plant 2026 09 10
text:
Sept 10 (Reuters) - Shell's (SHEL.L)
, opens new tab
 North American unit said on Thursday it has agreed to sell its interests in ​a gas-fired power plant complex in Rhode Island to ‌Constellation Energy (CEG.O)
, opens new tab
 for $715 million, while also expanding into the lucrative U.S. Mid-Atlantic power market.
Separately, the British oil and gas major will also acquire 100% ​equity in Hunlock Creek Generating, which owns 169 ​MW of natural gas-fired generation capacity in Pennsylvania.
The deals ⁠give Shell a larger footprint in the biggest North ​American power market — PJM Interconnection — where demand from data centers ​has sent prices paid to power plant operators skyrocketing over the last two years.
"We selectively invest in assets that strengthen our market position ​and create value, while remaining ready to realize value ​when market conditions present attractive opportunities," said Andrew Smith, Shell's president of ‌trading & ⁠supply.
The transaction also gives Constellation Energy, which is the country's biggest independent power producer, a presence in New England, where tight power supplies have pushed up electricity costs.
Under the deal, ​Constellation will ​acquire 100% interest ⁠in RISEC Holdings, which owns and operates the Rhode Island State Energy Center, from Shell.
The ​natural gas-fired energy center includes two combustion ​turbines and ⁠one steam turbine, and is capable of generating up to 609 megawatts of electricity.
Both the transactions are subject to regulatory ⁠approvals ​and are expected to close in ​the first quarter of 2027.
